archive.split_policy: 80/10/10 whole-trajectory hash; same-supplier development, not unseen-case proof
archive.training_policy: All observed actions retained, including failures. Outcomes separate. Simulations labeled. No preference pairs fabricated. No provider fine-tuning upload. No private reasoning included.

knowledge.policy: Knowledge/retrieval corpus, not invented conversation targets. Dated context in response training stays at the original case cutoff. Sunday evidence is final-only.

prompt_experiments.interpretation: Fresh stochastic sandbox runs on a matched case/repeat plan. V2 was adapted after the first v1 D02 result, so this is exploratory development. No automatic default promotion.

mixed_response_training.limitation: Historical development; local synthetic scores never replace official scores. Group exclusion prevents same case/supplier leakage. No causal policy improvement claimed.

corpus.data_policy: Visible messages and observed responses only; no server reasons, private scores or future evidence. Final-offer counters are observed risk examples, never instructions to over-negotiate.

tactical_training.limitation: Historical predictive development only; prospective outcome trials remain required.
